subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should maintainers split #88204 into separate canonical items for TUI default-session routing, WeChat route/session-id reconciliation, background-event flood isolation, and meaningful-activity listing, or keep it as one umbrella?
rationale: The current code and related issues show partial fixes and overlapping ownership, but the remaining work spans core Gateway/session semantics, TUI defaults, WeChat channel behavior, and product semantics for background events.

options.title: Split into focused canonical issues
options.body: Create or link separate owner-scoped items for each remaining behavior, using #51028 and #99704 where they already cover slices, then close this umbrella only after every slice has an owner.

options.title: Keep as one manual umbrella
options.body: Leave #88204 open as the tracking issue, but require maintainers to assign owners and proof expectations before any repair lane starts.

options.title: Close after narrower coverage is complete
options.body: Close this issue only once newer issues or merged PRs demonstrably cover the CLI, WeChat, background-event, and activity-timestamp parts.

recommendation.title: Split into focused canonical issues
recommendation.body: Create or link separate owner-scoped items for each remaining behavior, using #51028 and #99704 where they already cover slices, then close this umbrella only after every slice has an owner.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and PR metadata place vincentkoc on the central session, gateway, and TUI paths that need the split decision.
